source_documents.title: Saccharin-derived multifunctional emitters featuring concurrently room temperature phosphorescence, thermally activated delayed fluorescence and aggregation-induced enhanced emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: These close-distance intermolecular non-covalent interactions can effectively suppress the intramolecular motions and impede non-radiative decay channels, thus resulting in intense emission in aggregated states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series

reference_evidence_units.quote: The formation of aggregates could effectively block molecular motions and inhibit the non-radiative decay channels (e.g., the rotation of carbazole unit), resulting in the increased emission intensity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series

reference_evidence_units.quote: 348 ms for 6-Cz-Sac, 664 ms for 5-Cz-Sac, and 285 ms for DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series

reference_evidence_units.quote: may be caused by the trace amount of the carbazole isomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series
reference_evidence_units.statement: Ultralong lifetimes likely from a trace carbazole isomer; pure lab samples give ~2.5 ms RTP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: dark twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) states formed with the increase of solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series

reference_evidence_units.quote: were attributed to the ICT transition from carbazole to the saccharin moiety.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac series

reference_evidence_units.quote: DiCz-Sac exhibited TADF properties with a delayed lifetime of 3.2 μs in neat film state, in addition to AIEE and RTP.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: AIEE: aggregation and crystal contacts block carbazole rotation and suppress nonradiative decay.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Carbazole→saccharin ICT; dark TICT quenches at intermediate water fraction.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: DiCz-Sac: RTP in crystals and TADF in films (small ΔEST). The ultralong lifetimes are tentatively traced to a carbazole-isomer impurity.
